output.summary: Attempt 2 after review 1 (Changes needed, .ai-workflow/runs/U26-review-1.md). Production values unchanged (D31: SIGTERM->SIGKILL 12 s in claudeModels, STARTUP_MS.lean 30 s). Fixes: CLAUDE_STOP_MS frozen; lifecycle.ts comment states that a claude using its whole 15 s answer limit makes discovery up to 32 s, so such a start can still time out (safely: the service exits, the discovery claude gets EOF and ends itself); lean-lifecycle test renamed to what it proves ('the lean start wait is 10 s longer than a discovery claude's slowest stop'); tests/team-registry.test.mjs CLI limit 30 s -> STARTUP_MS.lean + 30000 (M1). Docs: solutions doc corrects 'runCommand never ends a claude' (discovery's claude --version / auth status are SIGKILLed on a 10 s timeout; follow-up), idle wording, flaky overclaim; claw-startup doc paragraph placement, line ref 266, merged note; verification doc rewritten with the Claw callers, 32 s case, waiter timing, unverified items (auth status, lean shutdown limit 10 s). Declined: shared constant with claude-controller.ts (boundary file -> re-qualification), M9. RED/GREEN from attempt 1 stand (3 tests RED before the change; mutations 4/4). Fresh related checks: runner-models + runner-settings + team-registry 57/57, lean-lifecycle startup test 1/1, typecheck exit 0, Story check exit 0.

Review 2 (same independent reviewer, report-only): Ready. Review 1 fixes correct; the timed-out-start safety claim verified (EOF on service exit; real claude 2.1.280 does not die of SIGPIPE). Non-blocking: N1 snippet and N2 STATUS fixed in docs, N3 test-name wording not changed, N4 user question on lean >= 42 s surfaced.

Fresh verification after review 2: npm test 1106/1106 exit 0 (11:10-11:12, after the last code change at 11:07); typecheck exit 0; Story check exit 0; focused 57/57 + 1/1. Changed product files: src/runners/runner-models.ts (CLAUDE_STOP_MS term 12 s, frozen), src/cli/lifecycle.ts (STARTUP_MS.lean 30 s). Limits: no new real-CLI run; real lean start under load not measured; 32 s no-answer case beyond 30 s (safe timeout, user question open).

D31 (user choice (a), 2026-10-30): claudeModels() waits 12 s after SIGTERM before SIGKILL (was 2 s); the three waits are CLAUDE_STOP_MS {input 3000, term 12000, kill 2000}; STARTUP_MS.lean 15 s -> 30 s because a live lean Office reports ready only after its first discovery (stop worst case 17 s). Refactor first (constants, behavior unchanged): runner-models 15/15. RED: new 'takes 9 s to release the lock after SIGTERM' failed (lock left), rewritten 'ignores SIGTERM too is killed once its 12 s grace runs out' failed ('ended' before 11.999 s), new lean-lifecycle 'lean start waits out a discovery claude's whole stop with 10 s to spare' failed (15000 < 17000). Both stop tests mock setTimeout and tick after the fake saw EOF/SIGTERM. GREEN: runner-models 16/16, startup test 1/1, runner-settings 18/18, typecheck exit 0, Story check exit 0. Mutations 4/4 caught (term 11999, 12001, 2000; lean 26999). Simplify: no change (reached/pause helper kept local to avoid tests/runner-fixture.mjs, which session launcher-hook-check is editing). Docs: Story D31, verification doc, STATUS, solutions docs (discovery stop, claw startup wait), #45 record follow-up pointer. D30/U25 are taken by the launcher-hook-check session.

Independent report-only review 1: Changes needed. Production change correct against D31. Important: I1 the 30 s lean wait / relational test do not cover a claude that does not answer within 15 s (discovery up to 32 s; safe failure); I2 solutions doc wrongly says runCommand never ends a claude (claude --version / auth status are SIGKILLed on a 10 s timeout). Minor M1-M9 (team-registry spawnSync 30 s limit, idle wording, 7.5 s waiter wording, claw synchronous discoveries, claw-startup doc refs, flaky overclaim, freeze constant, lean shutdown limit 10 s, unhandled rejection on failed test).
